concerns.text: T015 (Enhanced) depends on T015.1-Run (assets), but T016 (Reduced) explicitly states it does NOT depend on T015.1-Run. However, FR-002 requires BOTH versions for EVERY baseline image. If T015.1-Run fails, T015 halts but T016 proceeds, creating a dataset where some images lack the 'enhanced' version, violating the 'two manipulated versions per baseline' requirement. T016 must depend on T006.3-Filter (baseline availability) and T015.1-Run (to ensure the pipeline context is valid for the pair), or the task logic must ensure atomic generation of pairs.

T012 (Power Analysis) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but has a hard dependency on T012.0 (Effect Size Doc) and T060 (Scope Boundary). T012.1 (Gate) depends on T012. The 'Parallel' tag on T012 is misleading as it cannot run until T012.0 completes. While T012.0 is also [P], the strict sequential flow T060 -> T012.0 -> T012 -> T012.1 described in the 'EXECUTION FLOW' note contradicts the [P] tag which implies no ordering constraints. T012 should not be tagged [P] if it is part of a strict sequential gate chain.

T035 (ANOVA) depends on T012.1 (Power Gate). This is correct. However, T035 also depends on T017 (Stimulus Metadata Generation) and T027.3 (Response Capture). T017 is not explicitly defined as a task in the list (referenced in T027.2 and T038 dependencies but missing its own task entry). T035 cannot execute if T017 is missing. T017 must be added to the task list or its functionality merged into an existing task (e.g., T015/T016) to ensure the dependency chain is complete.

T080, T081, and T082 are marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, T081 depends on T080, and T082 depends on T080 and T081. This creates a strict sequential dependency (T080 -> T081 -> T082) which contradicts the [P] tag. These tasks should be untagged or the dependency chain should be reflected in the ordering.

T006.1-VG-Stream is marked [P] and has 'Dependency: None'. However, the task description states it streams from 'Visual Genome'. The plan.md specifies a 'Pre-bundled Subset' strategy for CI reproducibility. If T006.1 attempts to stream the full dataset without the pre-bundled subset logic (which is not explicitly defined as a separate task or a conditional branch in T006.1), it may fail on the free-tier runner (resource exhaustion) before T006.2 (Filter) can run. The task order assumes T006.1 succeeds, but the implementation strategy (Plan) suggests T006.1 might need to be conditional or replaced by a 'Load Pre-bundled' task first.
